dev.name: drop_index
dev.about: A migration drops the index the order history page relies on.

dev.name: planner_setting
dev.about: Someone sets random_page_cost far too high on the server, and index scans lose to sequential scans.

dev.name: lock_contention
dev.about: A batch job holds row locks on the hottest products in long transactions.

lockHolder.sql: UPDATE shop.products SET stock = stock WHERE id <= 40

dev.name: work_mem_spill
dev.about: work_mem is cut on the server and the daily report's aggregate spills to disk.

dev.name: n_plus_one
dev.about: A release replaces the batched basket lookup with one query per product.

dev.name: control
dev.about: Nothing changes. Any insight is a false alarm.

heldout.name: drop_composite_index
heldout.about: A cleanup drops the composite index behind the latest-invoices widget.

sql: CREATE INDEX invoices_account_issued_idx ON billing.invoices (account_id, issued_at DESC)

heldout.name: index_scans_disabled
heldout.about: A debugging session leaves enable_indexscan and enable_bitmapscan off on the server.

heldout.name: row_lock_holder
heldout.about: A reconciliation job locks the busiest accounts with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE and holds the transaction open.

lockHolder.sql: SELECT id FROM billing.accounts WHERE id <= 25 ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

heldout.name: role_work_mem
heldout.about: work_mem is lowered for the application role only, so only new application sessions spill.

heldout.name: n_plus_one_accounts
heldout.about: A release fetches account plans one by one instead of in one batch.

heldout.name: control
heldout.about: Nothing changes. Any insight is a false alarm.
